mainEntity.name: Can I convert my existing tub into a walk-in shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, converting an existing bathtub into a walk-in shower is a popular renovation choice, particularly for enhancing accessibility or updating a bathroom's look. This conversion typically involves removing the tub, modifying plumbing, and installing a new shower pan, walls, and fixtures. The feasibility depends on the existing bathroom layout and plumbing. This offers a practical tradeoff between retaining a tub and gaining a more spacious, accessible shower.
